I've finally gotten round to opening the project again and fixing some things in preparation for the steam release.[/p][p][/p][p]Time was mainly spent reworking the input UI, which used to be quite chaotic and fixing some weird bugs such as:[/p][list][*][p]Localization not loading but logging it is[/p][/*][*][p]Input-System shenanigans where clicks weren't being registered due to changed bindings[/p][/*][*][p]Combo not calculating properly[/p][/*][/list][h2]Old Input Information[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45566166/39bdfb2efa683d58d6cd1f774c71bd4012f765be.png"][/img][/p][h2]New Input Information[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45566166/fcf13b224e302fb3d81ad9fc7fe2a68fff18b179.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]That's all for now :)[/p][list][*][p]Robin Welmers[/p][/*][/list]
